visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a stylized animation on a light blue background featuring white clouds. A green car is driving on a gray asphalt road. A large black text box with yellow characters appears at the top. (2) The scene transitions to show a comparison of road widths, using white dotted lines and labels like '3m' and '∞m'. A pink car driven by a cartoon black bear character appears. The bear has a small white V-shape on its chest and a neutral expression. (3) Data visualization phase: A graph with colorful curved lines (blue, green, pink, yellow) appears, showing the relationship between lane width and accident rates. Cars are shown moving along these lanes to illustrate traffic density. (4) Transition to real-world footage: An aerial and eye-level view of a multi-lane street in an urban setting. A bright red transparent overlay highlights a trapezoidal section of the road known as channelization. (5) Drone footage of a large intersection in Hsinchu City, showing white lane markings, arrows, and traffic signals. Several cars and a bus are visible moving through the intersection. (6) The video ends with a white background featuring the Hsinchu City Government logo, which is a stylized red circular emblem, and accompanying text.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar strumming begins accompanied by a steady drum beat. A male narrator introduces the topic of road safety with a clear, enthusiastic tone. A 'pop' SFX is heard as text graphics appear on screen. (2) The narrator continues explaining road width research. Mid-frequency 'ding' and 'thud' SFX are synchronized with the appearance of cartoon cars and text bubbles. The BGM remains consistent in tempo. (3) The vocal delivery slows slightly as data and graphs are presented, maintaining a professional but accessible tone. Subtle 'click' sound effects occur when chart lines are drawn. (4) Real-world footage begins; the audio remains studio-clean with the narrator summarizing the benefits of narrow lanes. The BGM maintains its major-key energy. (5) The final segment concludes with a call to action and the government logo. The BGM swells briefly and fades out smoothly to silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Explanation -> Data Evidence -> Real-world Application -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To educate the public on the counter-intuitive concept that narrower traffic lanes can actually improve road safety and traffic flow, specifically promoting the urban planning efforts of the Hsinchu City Government.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video ends with the official logo of the Hsinchu City Government and promotes their specific road layout improvements.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses mixed-media (animation and real footage) to explain complex urban planning concepts in an accessible way for a general audience.
